title: An AI-Powered Chatbot Targeting Nicotine and Cannabis Dual Vaping Cessation in Young Adults
official: An AI-Powered Chatbot Targeting Nicotine and Cannabis Dual Vaping Cessation in Young Adults (Aim 2)
summary: A pilot study evaluates the feasibility and acceptability of D-QUIT, an AI-powered smartphone app providing personalized behavioral support for nicotine and cannabis vaping cessation among young adults.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Speak English.
2. Ages 18-29.
3. Live in California.
4. Own a smartphone.
5. Report vaping nicotine frequently (20+ days during the past month).
6. Report vaping cannabis at least weekly.
7. Intent to quit vaping nicotine in the next 30 days.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Younger than 18 years or older than 29 years of age.
2. unable to read, speak, or understand English.
3. Unwilling or unable to participate or give informed consent.
4. Do not own a smartphone.
5. have not vaped nicotine at least 20 days in the past month.
6. Have not vaped cannabis at least weekly.
7. Not thinking about quitting vaping within the next 30 days.
8. Do not live in California.
